number_format: Inputs are binary64: 'binary64' is the shortest round-trip decimal, 'hex' the exact hex form, 'exact' the exact rational. Derived reals are decimal strings ('value', 40 significant digits unless stated) with the nearest binary64. 'exact' on a derived quantity is an exact rational.

SEC-A.units: SI: m, kg/m^3, Pa; mbar kg/m; jbar and ibar kg m; EI N m^2; EA N; GJ N m^2

SEC-B.units: SI: m, kg/m^3, Pa; mbar kg/m; jbar and ibar kg m; EI N m^2; EA N; GJ N m^2

rods.note: mbar includes contents and insulation; jbar excludes contents (D-e)

rayleigh.equation_ss: omega^2 = EI a^4/(mbar + ibar a^2), a = n pi/L; nondimensional Om^2 = (n pi)^4/(1 + r2 (n pi)^2), r2 = ibar/(mbar L^2)

kernel_pencil.note: one Hermitian element, root fixed; M singular (one infinite eigenvalue)

axial_chains.layout: ground -k- m1 -k- m2 ... -k- mN (free): N springs, N masses
ground -k- m1 -k- m2 ... -k- mN (free): N springs, N masses
ground -k- m1 -k- m2 ... -k- mN (free): N springs, N masses

tip_mass.equation: 1 + cos x cosh x + mu x (cos x sinh x - sin x cosh x) = 0, x = beta L, mu = M_t/(mbar L)
tip_mass.premise: tip mass is a point mass at the free end: no rotary inertia, no offset

rings.premises: thin circular ring of the section, Euler-Bernoulli curved bar: no shear deformation, no warping, no ovalization (flexibility factor 1), free (no supports); each n >= 1 is a double eigenvalue (cos and sin forms)

variants.inplane_extensible_rotary: roots of 2x2: K=[[al+n^4, al n+n^3],[al n+n^3, al n^2+n^2]], M=[[1+rho n^2, rho n],[rho n, 1+rho]], al = A R^2/I; low = flexural, high = extensional
variants.outofplane_love: n^2 (n^2-1)^2/(n^2 + EI/GJ): torsional and rotary inertia neglected (Love)
variants.outofplane_torsion_rotary: roots of 2x2: K=[[n^4+ga n^2, n^2+ga n^2],[n^2+ga n^2, 1+ga n^2]], M=[[1+rho n^2, 0],[0, rho_t]], ga = GJ/EI, rho_t = jbar/(mbar R^2); low = flexural, high = torsional
